originalTitle: U.S.-listed Greenland stocks surge after Trump announces security deal with Denmark
summary: The rally followed a U.S.-Denmark-Greenland security pact aimed at expanding the military presence on the Arctic territory.
content:
Shares of U.S.-listed companies exposed to Greenland surged on Monday after the U.S. and Denmark reached a deal on security arrangements on the Arctic territory.

Shares of Greenland Energy soared 159%, with Greenland Mines seen up more than 200% and Critical Metals Corp nearly 37% higher.

The agreement, which is expected to be signed during the United Nations General Assembly this week, will see the U.S., Denmark and Greenland enter into a pact to develop a significant military presence on the territory, while blocking Washington's adversaries from building their own bases there.

It follows several months of U.S. President Donald Trum p's threats to annex the self-governing Danish territory, with the president insisting Greenland is critical to U.S. national security.

Announcing the deal, Trump said via Truth Social on Friday that the U.S. would "FOREVER have the complete ability to do what is necessary in Greenland in order to secure and defend the security of Greenland, and the United States of America."

Trump said the agreement would come at no cost to the U.S., adding that Washington would "immediately begin the process of developing a large Military presence in the appropriate part of Greenland, of which there are many."

Key details of the agreement have not yet been made public.

Greenlandic and Danish officials sought to reassure citizens over the weekend that the deal would respect the island's right to self-determination and the sovereignty of the Danish kingdom.

"It is joyous that we are about to make an agreement that will ensure and strengthen the security of Greenland, the Kingdom of Denmark, the United States and the Western Alliance," Greenland's Prime Minister Jens-Frederik Nielsen said in a statement.

"The agreement recognizes Greenland's interests and our place in the international cooperation. It is to the benefit of us all," he added.

Greenland Energy is an oil and gas exploration firm focused on trying to unlock the hydrocarbon potential of the Jameson Land Basin on the island's east coast.

The Texas-based company, which has links to Trump , recently delayed plans to drill for oil in Greenland after the island's government issued a " strong warning " to its joint venture partner for bringing equipment ashore without permission.

Greenland Mines, meanwhile, is a natural resources company working on the Skaergaard Project, which ranks among the world's largest undeveloped palladium, gold and platinum deposits.

Critical Metals Corp, for its part, is a mining company focused on critical metals and minerals and is developing the Tanbreez rare earths mine in southern Greenland.
chineseTitle: 特朗普宣布与丹麦达成安全协议后，在美国上市的格陵兰股票飙升
chineseSummary: 这次集会是在美国、丹麦、格陵兰签署旨在扩大北极领土军事存在的安全协议之后举行的。
chineseContent:
在美国和丹麦就北极领土安全安排达成协议后，参与格陵兰岛业务的美国上市公司股价周一飙升。

格陵兰能源公司股价飙升 159%，格陵兰矿业公司股价上涨超过 200%，凯瑞金属公司股价上涨近 37%。

该协议预计将于本周在联合国大会期间签署，美国、丹麦和格陵兰岛将达成协议，在该领土上建立重要的军事存在，同时阻止华盛顿的对手在那里建立自己的基地。

几个月前，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普威胁要吞并丹麦自治领土，并坚称格陵兰岛对美国国家安全至关重要。

特朗普周五通过真相社会宣布这项协议时表示，美国将“永远拥有在格陵兰岛采取必要行动的完全能力，以确保和捍卫格陵兰岛和美利坚合众国的安全。”

特朗普表示，该协议不会让美国付出任何代价，并补充说华盛顿将“立即开始在格陵兰岛适当地区建立大规模军事存在的进程，格陵兰岛有很多军事存在”。

该协议的关键细节尚未公布。

格陵兰和丹麦官员周末试图向公民保证，该协议将尊重该岛的自决权和丹麦王国的主权。

格陵兰岛总理延斯·弗雷德里克·尼尔森在一份声明中表示：“令人高兴的是，我们即将达成一项协议，以确保和加强格陵兰岛、丹麦王国、美国和西方联盟的安全。”

“该协议承认格陵兰岛的利益以及我们在国际合作中的地位。这对我们所有人都有好处，”他补充道。

格陵兰能源公司是一家石油和天然气勘探公司，致力于挖掘该岛东海岸詹姆森陆地盆地的碳氢化合物潜力。

这家总部位于德克萨斯州、与特朗普有联系的公司最近推迟了在格陵兰岛开采石油的计划，此前该岛政府向其合资伙伴发出“强烈警告”，要求其未经许可将设备带上岸。

与此同时，格陵兰矿业公司是一家致力于斯卡尔加德项目的自然资源公司，该项目是世界上最大的未开发钯、金和铂矿床之一。

Critical Metals Corp 是一家专注于关键金属和矿物的矿业公司，正在开发位于格陵兰岛南部的 Tanbreez 稀土矿。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
